news.title: University of Minnesota awarded $20 million to expand scientific drilling on large bodies of water
news.summary_en: The National Science Foundation has awarded $20 million to a University of Minnesota-led project to develop a modular drilling platform for research on large lakes and in nearshore marine settings. The system will allow scientists to collect samples at sites that existing systems cannot reach.

news.title: University of Minnesota launches Interdisciplinary Computing major
news.summary_en: The University of Minnesota Twin Cities is launching Interdisciplinary Computing, an undergraduate major that combines a foundation in computer science with in-depth study in another discipline.
